Method of Attack: Abuses Android accessibility features to steal sensitive financial data
Retrieves notifications about other installed applications and content of open windows
Reads and receives SMS messages to steal one-time passcodes (OTPs) to bypass SMS-based two-factor authentication (2FA)
Collects list of installed apps and device info and sends to command-and-control server
Launches after system boot for persistence
Runs in background ignoring battery optimizations and preventing device sleep/dimming
Attack Vector: Distribution via shady APK hosting websites and rogue APK marketplaces, not Google Play Store
Indicators of Compromise: Malware sample hashes, IP addresses, and domains of command and control servers (available in Cybereason Nocturnus report)
